The decoder converts entry offsets to signed values and reads replacements for glyph IDs from `max(0, ceil(substOffset/2) - offset)` up to `min(numGlyphs, floor(size/2) - offset)`. These bounds include every glyph whose complete replacement word lies within the substitution table and the subtable, for either sign of offset; the new subtable reader prevents reads into subsequent subtables.
